messages.text:
You awaken to the serene yet eerie atmosphere of Woking, unaware that humanity is about to face its darkest hour. The sky is filled with meteors, and an ominous cylinder has crashed nearby. You find yourself drawn to it, sensing that the fate of the world may hinge on your actions. Your first decision could define your path: will you investigate the cylinder, or seek out the local astronomer, Ogilvy?


- Investigate the cylinder
- Seek out Ogilvy

You hustle towards the observatory, your heart pounding with urgency. As you approach, you spot Ogilvy pacing anxiously outside, a deep frown etched on his face. He seems aware of the meteor shower's significance and may have insights into the cylinder. You can see the flicker of fear in his eyes as he glances back towards the crash site. 

"Did you see the meteor? It is unlike anything I have ever observed," he says, catching your gaze. "We need to act quickly, but I require your assistance. Will you help me gather the tools I need?"

Agree to help Ogilvy gather tools

You nod, sensing the gravity of the situation. Ogilvy's relief is palpable as he leads you inside the observatory. Together, you collect various instruments—telescopes, notepads, and a peculiar device that resembles a gunpowder flask. Ogilvy explains that the tools will help him analyze any samples from the cylinder while keeping a safe distance.

As you exit the observatory, a sense of dread settles in your stomach. The sky begins to darken, and strange noises emerge from the direction of the cylinder. You must decide your next move carefully, as time is of the essence.
